evals.prompt: Can you review this user story from Azure DevOps with the INVEST framework and tell me if it's ready for sprint planning? Work item: https://dev.azure.com/contoso/webapp/_workitems/edit/12345. Description: 'As a user, I want the search page to be better.' Acceptance criteria: 'Search should work well and be fast.'
evals.expected_output: The story is not ready — its INVEST average score falls below 4.
expectations: Scores all six INVEST criteria (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable) with a numeric score for each.
Reports the average INVEST score as a number.
States the story is not ready and ties that verdict to the average score being below 4.
Names the weak criteria (such as untestable or missing acceptance criteria) rather than only giving a verdict.
